adaptation_disclosure.confirmation_requirement: Champion status requires a separately preregistered exact-identity evaluation on genuinely untouched historical or subsequently accumulated data. V4 cannot consume the existing protected final.
adaptation_disclosure.inference_limit: Every V4 return measured on the reused development period is adaptive provisional discovery evidence, even if all numerical promotion gates pass.

budget_derivation.call_cap_rationale: 3300 permits one call per factorial plan plus 228 charged synthesis or retry calls without making calls the expected stop.
budget_derivation.candidate_cap_rationale: The fixed 3072-plan factorial requires about 14.1 hours at clean V3 throughput, so the 12-hour wall clock is expected to control while the plan cap remains a hard safety boundary.
budget_derivation.token_cap_rationale: 3300 calls multiplied by the V3 per-call reservation of 16384 tokens.

implementation_claim: This file preregisters the intended V4 offline campaign. It does not claim that V4 code, readiness, a ticket, campaign execution, profit, or a champion exists.

launch_authorization.condition: Implementation and tests must pass, a new V4 readiness artifact must bind code data gates budgets and protected denial, and a one-use ticket must be issued before launch.
launch_authorization.source_or_gate_changes_after_readiness: invalidate readiness and require a hash-bound amendment or new registration

objective.market_scope: Kalshi KXHIGHLAX daily maximum temperature purchased contracts held to settlement

positive_return_behavior: A positive primary development return stops the campaign only when every gate other than the 10 percent aggregate-return threshold passes. Any weaker positive result is recorded and the fixed factorial continues without relaxing any gate.
readiness_requirements: new V4 plan schema and compiler bind every added control and reject unregistered values
outcome-blind funnel proves that settlement labels and scored development outcomes are not read
balanced allocator passes exact coverage-floor fixtures
all V3 promotion gates are reproduced unchanged
protected-final negative-capability checks deny every V4 process
wall-time call candidate token retry and concurrency limits are deterministic and hash-bound
campaign can resume without refunding consumed calls candidates or wall time
independent verifier and critic can reproduce and assess the exact candidate identity
actual pinned local GPT-OSS V4 nomination and synthesis protocol probes pass with exact ResearchPlanV4 identity and no tools network or protected-final access
new readiness artifact and one-use campaign ticket are issued after all implementation tests pass

result_labels.INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: Integrity, opportunity count, replication, critic, or resource evidence was insufficient for a valid conclusion.
result_labels.NO_IMPROVEMENT_WITHIN_REGISTERED_BUDGET: No candidate had strictly positive primary capital-weighted development return before a registered limit ended the search.
result_labels.PROVISIONAL_POSITIVE_RETURN_ONLY: No candidate passed every gate, but at least one candidate had strictly positive primary capital-weighted development return. This is a hypothesis for confirmation, not demonstrated profitability.
result_labels.PROVISIONAL_ROBUST_POSITIVE_GATE_PASS: A candidate had strictly positive primary capital-weighted return and passed every promotion gate except the 10 percent aggregate-return threshold. It is frozen for future untouched confirmation but is not a champion.
result_labels.PROVISIONAL_V4_DEVELOPMENT_GATE_PASS: At least one exact candidate passed every unchanged V3 numerical and logical promotion gate on adaptively reused development data. It is frozen for a future untouched confirmation contract but is not a champion.

search_space_coverage.adaptive_behavior: Agents may use completed scored evidence only for the six adaptive slots. Every selected plan must be an untested member of the preregistered 3072-plan universe; agents may not add an operator, value, model track, gate, or data source.

adaptive_slot_rules.adversarial_challenge: Choose an untested factorial plan most capable of falsifying a current leader or diagnosis, including stricter controls, adjacent decision time, or a different model track.
adaptive_slot_rules.cross_track_or_cross_control_combine: Choose an untested factorial plan that takes the model track from one supported parent and execution controls from a structurally distinct supported parent.
adaptive_slot_rules.evidence_guided_deepen: Choose an untested factorial plan adjacent to a supported parent in exactly one registered axis, prioritizing the parent's principal rejection bottleneck.
adaptive_slot_rules.fallback: If an adaptive role has no valid distinct proposal, consume the slot with the next forced-coverage plan. Never leave a slot empty while an untested registered plan remains.
adaptive_slot_rules.independent_alternative: Choose the untested factorial plan with greatest registered-axis distance from evaluated plans, subject to unmet coverage floors.

coverage_protection.adaptive_admission_rule: An adaptive choice is rejected when it would make a currently reachable registered marginal floor unreachable with the remaining budget.

search_space_coverage.forced_coverage_queue: Construct prospectively from the 3072-plan universe using the outcome-blind funnel triple order and an orthogonal round-robin over model track, decision time, interval width, quote age, spread, and price band. In every completed eight-epoch block, the 48 forced slots must contain 12 plans from each four-level axis and 16 plans from each decision-time level; partial-block marginal counts may differ by at most one wherever arithmetically possible.

model_track_contracts.non_gaussian_ensemble_mixture: Registered finite non-Gaussian mixture using admitted HRRR, GEFS mean/spread, and local as-of features, calibrated only with permitted training and calibration rows.
model_track_contracts.regime_conditioned_quantile_isotonic: The same admitted weather evidence with the registered local-weather regime classifier, pooled fallback, quantile brackets, and isotonic calibration.
model_track_contracts.regularized_market_residual_combination: Frozen V3 weather probabilities combined with a regularized market-residual model fit only on the fixed calibration prefix using registered market features.
model_track_contracts.v3_fixed_quantile_isotonic: Frozen V3 HRRR and GEFS-summary temperature pipeline with pooled regimes, quantile brackets, isotonic calibration, and no market-residual model.

search_space_coverage.nonzero_trade_ranking: Order first by number of passed promotion gates, then robust-positive status, primary capital-weighted return, bootstrap lower bound, stressed return, trade count, forecast scores, and canonical compiled-plan hash.

lexicographic_order: more distinct development days reaching the expected-return screen after interval and market-evidence controls
more contract-side decisions reaching the expected-return screen
more distinct days reaching market screening after the interval-width control
fewer normalized first failures at spread then price-band then quote-freshness controls
lower CRPS then lower Brier score
zero_trade_ranking.restriction: Opportunity-funnel depth and rejection evidence rank zero-trade candidates for research allocation only; they do not count as return, a gate pass, or evidence of profitability.

stage_0_outcome_blind_opportunity_funnel.funnel_use: Audit market-evidence availability and determine the outcome-blind order of the 64 quote-age by spread by price-band triples. The funnel excludes no preregistered factorial plan.
stage_0_outcome_blind_opportunity_funnel.opportunity_definition: A calibration-prefix settlement day with at least one contract side having a recorded eligible price that passes interval-width, price-band, quote-age, and spread controls. Expected return and settlement outcome are not evaluated.
stage_0_outcome_blind_opportunity_funnel.purpose: Choose executable market-evidence policies without using settlement outcomes, simulated payouts, profit, expected edge, CRPS, or Brier score.
stage_0_outcome_blind_opportunity_funnel.required_artifact: A hash-bound table for all 768 execution policies containing only outcome-blind opportunity, freshness, spread, coverage, registered controls, and deterministic schedule fields.
stage_0_outcome_blind_opportunity_funnel.triple_order: For each quote-age by spread by price-band triple, sum distinct opportunity days across the 12 decision-time by interval-width cells; order descending by that sum, then ascending by quote-age cap, spread cap, price-band width, price lower bound descending, price upper bound ascending, and canonical JSON hash.
stage_0_outcome_blind_opportunity_funnel.zero_opportunity_treatment: Retain the plan, schedule its triple after every positive-coverage triple, and report the negative evidence. Do not inspect scored outcomes to reorder or remove it.
